### BASIC error messages

| Code | Name | Message | Raised when |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$00` | `ERR_NOFOR` | `?NEXT WITHOUT FOR ERROR` | NEXT ran with no FOR loop active, or named a variable that has no active loop. |
| `$10` | `ERR_SYNTAX` | `?SYNTAX ERROR` | BASIC cannot parse the statement: an unknown or misspelled keyword, or a missing parenthesis, comma or quote. READ of a non-number into a numeric variable also raises it, on the DATA line. |
| `$16` | `ERR_NOGOSUB` | `?RETURN WITHOUT GOSUB ERROR` | RETURN ran with no GOSUB active. |
| `$2A` | `ERR_NODATA` | `?OUT OF DATA ERROR` | READ, or a statement that reads DATA (NTREAD, ATRREAD, CHRREAD, PALREAD, OAMREAD), ran past the last DATA item. |
| `$35` | `ERR_ILLQTY` | `?ILLEGAL QUANTITY ERROR` | A value is outside what a statement or function accepts: an argument outside a keyword's range, SQR of a negative number, LOG of 0 or less, or an integer (%) value outside -32768 to 32767. |
| `$45` | `ERR_OVERFLOW` | `?OVERFLOW ERROR` | A number is too large for BASIC (above about 1.7E38), or a hex number has a digit past $FFFFFF. |
| `$4D` | `ERR_MEMFULL` | `?OUT OF MEMORY ERROR` | The program, variables, arrays and strings no longer fit, or FOR loops, GOSUBs and parentheses nest too deeply for the stack. |
| `$5A` | `ERR_UNDEFSTAT` | `?UNDEF'D STATEMENT ERROR` | GOTO, GOSUB, THEN, ON or RUN names a line number that does not exist. |
| `$6B` | `ERR_BADSUBS` | `?BAD SUBSCRIPT ERROR` | An array index is larger than the array's DIM (10 for an array used without DIM), or the number of indexes does not match. |
| `$78` | `ERR_REDIMD` | `?REDIM'D ARRAY ERROR` | DIM names an array that already exists, including one BASIC created when it was first used without DIM. |
| `$85` | `ERR_ZERODIV` | `?DIVISION BY ZERO ERROR` | A division by zero. |
| `$95` | `ERR_ILLDIR` | `?ILLEGAL DIRECT ERROR` | INPUT, GET or DEF was typed as a direct command; they only work inside a program. |
| `$A3` | `ERR_BADTYPE` | `?TYPE MISMATCH ERROR` | A string where a number is expected or the reverse, such as comparing a string with a number or reading a file byte into a string variable. |
| `$B0` | `ERR_STRLONG` | `?STRING TOO LONG ERROR` | A string result would be longer than 255 characters. |
| `$BF` | `ERR_FRMCPX` | `?FORMULA TOO COMPLEX ERROR` | A string expression needs more than three temporary strings at once, as with deeply nested string functions; split it with a variable. |
| `$D2` | `ERR_CANTCONT` | `?CAN'T CONTINUE ERROR` | CONT has no stopped program to resume: nothing was stopped, or an error, a program edit, CLEAR, NEW or RUN came after the stop. |
| `$E0` | `ERR_UNDEFFN` | `?UNDEF'D FUNCTION ERROR` | FN called a function that no DEF FN has defined. |
| `$F0` | `ERR_FILEIO` | `?FILE I/O ERROR` | An SD card or file operation failed: no card, a missing file or directory, a full card, a directory that is not empty, or a file number that is not open. |

Other messages:

| Message | Printed when |
| --- | --- |
| `?EXTRA IGNORED` | INPUT got more comma-separated values than it has variables. The extra values are dropped and the program continues. |
| `?REDO FROM START` | INPUT got text where it needs a number. It prints this and asks for the whole line again. |
| `BREAK` | STOP ran, or Ctrl+C was pressed while a program ran. BASIC prints BREAK IN and the line number, and CONT resumes. |
